name: Live Band Karaoke
style: Party covers from the 80s and 90s onward
spec: Voice and guitar, keys, bass, drums, and a host working the mic
alt: A microphone on a stand beside a lyric screen with one line lit in brass, drawn flat on a dark field.
blurb: This party band plays 80s and 90s hits on its own, then hands the mic to anyone in the crowd who wants a turn. The words are up on a screen, and the band follows whoever's singing.
